title: Emailed instructions and feature requests
summary: The topic groups brief mentions of emailed troubleshooting or instructions together with emailed customer requests, so the sample is mostly administrative and not strongly evaluative.

negative.summary: The negative feedback concerns emailed follow-up troubleshooting steps in case a problem returns, implying the issue was not fully resolved at the time.

undetermined.summary: The undetermined reviews mention emailed instructions and customer requests such as changing honking behavior or wanting an oil dipstick, but they do not clearly express satisfaction or dissatisfaction.

limitations: The sample is very small and mostly undetermined, so concrete sentiment patterns are limited.
This topic mixes administrative follow-up messages with unrelated product requests, which reduces thematic coherence.
Several fragments are too brief to determine whether the customer viewed the outcome positively or negatively.
